author: Praxis I
title: Dual BRBG: Global Soft-Whiten + Per-Batch Variance Equalization (alpha_pb=0.3)
abstract: Building on the whitened ComBat PCA64 embedding (tau=0.95), we equalize per-batch variances per PC in a fixed basis with alpha_pb=0.3 to reduce second-order batch discrepancies. Graph remains residualized PC50 with adaptive per-PC shrinkage and equal-quota balanced cosine kNN (k=45).
